description: Response from token introspection conforming to RFC 7662.

scope.description: A JSON string containing a space-separated list of scopes associated with this token, in the format described in Section 3.3 of OAuth 2.0

aud.description: The audience (realm or OAuth Client) the token was issued for

sub.description: Subject identifier. For a first-party access token, this is the Synapse user ID. For tokens issued to OAuth Clients, this is a PPID (Pairwise Pseudonymous Identifier)

auth_time.description: Time of user authentication (seconds since epoch)
